result.description:
IT Desktop Support position available within SQS Group in all states, work assignment may either be in NSW, QLD, SA, VIC, or WA

Southern Steel Group and its subsidiaries specialise in providing the nest steel products, sheet & coil, and expert steel processing and distribution. Our company network is extensive, represented in every Australian state.

Southern Queensland Steel is part of the Southern Steel Group, the largest privately-owned steel company in Australia. With more than 1400 employees nationwide, the foundations of this company are built on strong values and a sense of family belonging.

We service our customers through multiple SQS businesses and division affiliates in various States in Australia. In NSW: Steelpipes, Piling Solutions Australia, Rigby Jones, Rollco, Metal Shop Technics, Southern Sheet & Coil, Coil Processors. In QLD: RPG Australia. In Victoria: Surdex Steel, Smithweld Bending, KOMO Metform Engineering, Alliance Laser, Surdex Sheet & Coil, Eliott Engineering, Australian Rollforming Manufacturers. In SA: Brice Metals, Ferrocut. In WA: WA Cutting Services, Boyd Metal Industries

To succeed in this position, you will need to have industry related experience within similar positions, a strong work ethic and strong safety focus. The ability to carry out work with minimal supervision, a keen and enthusiastic approach to your work and willingness to work over time will help you ensure success in this role.

MAIN OBJECTIVE
To provide 1st and 2nd level IT helpdesk support on all end user equipment and systems for all users across the business.

DUTIES
Providing 1st/2nd level telephone and customer-facing support for initial fault diagnosis
The creation and deletion of new users across all internal systems
Setup of all new mobile/tablet devices
Install, configure and maintain network devices including but not restricted to PCs, Printers, Print Servers, Terminal Servers, Switches and application software
Hardware relocations and re-configurations (eg. PCs and telephones)
Monitoring and reporting on hardware, software and network resources to ensure a high level of performance, security and integrity
Assisting with the administration and support of the local area network, servers and printing facilities
Work within strict time frames and elevate incidents within defined timeframes
Creating, managing and supporting SOE builds for Desktop and Laptop PC’s
Maintain a good working knowledge of current infrastructure and future trends
All employees are subject to legal obligations regarding their own and their fellow workers Work Health & Safety (WH&S). They are to fully co-operate with the company WH&S Policy and Program, to ensure safety in the workplace is maintained. All employees shall undertake hazard identification as part of their normal duties, and report any unsafe conditions or work practices. All employees are responsible for their own safety as well as those around them.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED
Windows 7/10/11, Windows Server 2008/2012R2/2016/2019/2022, Active Directory (DNS, DHCP, etc)
Experience with Windows, iPhone, Android phones
Experience using a variety of PC software including the Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Exchange, Windows servers and desktops, and anti-virus software
Experience in security administration utilising active directory and group policy
Knowledge and understanding of end user requirements
Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong working relationships
Strong customer service orientation
A professional, reliable and team orientated approach to work
MS HyperV/VMware
Experience with remote software tools such as TeamViewer, LogMein
Good understanding of Networking, TCP/IP and WiFi environments
Knowledge of Linux/UNIX would be an advantage
Experience with supporting HP SAN technology would be an advantage
Experience with HP Server Products
Understanding of Agile, Kanban methodologies

The successful applicant will be joining a secure, reputable organisation who o er their employees’ opportunities for career progression.

Employer:Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited
Location: 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, NSW 2178, Australia
Employment type: Full-time, 38 hours per week
Remuneration: $75,000 - $85,000 

About Rita Farm
Since its establishment in 2001, Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited has been deeply engaged in Australia's organic agriculture sector for over 20 years. It is a highly reputable certified organic family farm in New South Wales, located at 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, covering an area of 55 acres. Adhering to strict organic farming standards, the farm consistently upholds the core philosophy of "growing food as medicine" and is committed to providing high-quality organic fruits, vegetables, and baked goods—free of chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers—to Sydney, Canberra, and surrounding regions.
We adhere to sustainable agricultural practices and protect biodiversity through ecological balance technologies, having now become a benchmark brand in the local organic agriculture sector. To support the farm's large-scale development and the refined management of its irrigation systems, we are sincerely inviting professional irrigation technicians to join us in jointly safeguarding the core lifeline of organic farming.

Duties & Responsibilities
System Operation & Maintenance Management: Responsible for the daily operation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of drip/sprinkler irrigation systems (including water pumps, pipelines, etc.), ensuring the precise irrigation needs of 55 acres of organic crops are met.
Irrigation Plan Development: Develop scientific irrigation plans based on organic standards, crop cycles, soil, and climate data. Precisely control water volume and frequency to ensure certification compliance.
Fertigation Integration Operation: Operate relevant equipment to precisely mix organic fertilizers for simultaneous irrigation. Monitor the process and record data to ensure efficient nutrient absorption.
Data Optimization & Review: Establish operation records for irrigation systems, documenting equipment status, test data, etc. Regularly analyze efficiency and propose optimization or upgrade suggestions.
Safety & Collaboration Assurance: Adhere to WHS (Work Health and Safety) standards. Coordinate with the planting team and farm manager to provide irrigation technical support and participate in planting planning meetings.

Selection Criteria / Skills & Qualifications
Possess 1-3 years of relevant experience in irrigation system installation/maintenance, or practical experience in horticultural/agricultural irrigation.
Proficient in the operation and maintenance of core irrigation system components, including pumps, valves, piping, and irrigation controllers, with a solid understanding of water supply scheduling logic.
Have a basic grasp of the principles of hydraulic parameters in agricultural/horticultural settings and an understanding of water resource optimization and management methods.
Adaptable to outdoor working environments, capable of independently completing physical work tasks, and equipped with reliable maintenance execution capabilities.
Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, able to effectively collaborate with farm teams and management.
Meticulous and reliable in work, prioritize work safety, strictly comply with labour hire industry standards, and adhere to high-quality craftsmanship requirements.
Flexible to adjust work arrangements in line with the farm’s production cycles.

What We Offer
Competitive salary for a full-time, 38-hour week role.
Stable employment with compliant labour-hire arrangements, including rostered hours, structured workforce management, and professional work conditions aligned with our values of integrity, reliability, and compliance.

More information

•	Ensure the maintenance history for farm vehicles, are recorded, and that relevant records and reports are prepared as required.
•	Contribute to the successful delivery of workshop projects, taking responsibility as directed.

•	Repair and replace worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components and referring to service manuals as needed.

•	All other requirements as directed to achieve business objectives.
